g.title: B2 Use of English phần 1 · The quiet carriage
g.gist: An article about quiet carriages on trains and why passengers value them.
g.vi: Đọc bài, chọn từ đúng cho 8 chỗ trống.
g.text:
The quiet carriage

Many train companies now offer a quiet carriage, where passengers are asked not to make phone calls or play music out loud. The idea was first [1] as a small experiment, but it has become extremely popular with people who want to work or simply rest during their journey.

Of course, not everyone [2] by the rules. Some passengers say they did not notice the signs, while others seem to think a short call does not [3] as breaking them. Train staff are usually reluctant to get involved, so it is often left to other travellers to [4] the problem.

Researchers who studied passenger behaviour found that people who sit in the quiet carriage are more likely to [5] on a task than those in ordinary carriages. They also reported feeling less tired at the end of the journey. [6] the occasional argument, most regular users believe the quiet carriage is worth defending.

Some companies are now considering [7] the idea further, with "quiet zones" in stations. Whether these will catch [8] remains to be seen.

groups.inst: Read the text and decide which answer best fits each gap.

items.why_vi: "an idea was introduced as an experiment" = được đưa ra thử nghiệm. "founded" dùng cho tổ chức, "appeared" không có bị động.
Chỉ "abide" đi với giới từ "by": "abide by the rules" (tuân theo luật). "follows / obeys / keeps" không cần "by".
"count as" = được tính là: "a short call does not count as breaking them" (cuộc gọi ngắn không bị coi là phạm luật). "regard / consider / see" cần tân ngữ: "regard something as".
"deal with the problem" = xử lý vấn đề. "put up with" là chịu đựng, trái ý; "come up with" là nghĩ ra.
"concentrate on a task" = tập trung vào việc. "devote" cần "to" và tân ngữ, "attend" cần "to", "pay" cần "attention".
Trước cụm danh từ "the occasional argument" dùng "Despite". "Although" cần mệnh đề, "However" không đứng như vậy.
Cụm "take an idea further" = phát triển ý tưởng thêm. "consider" đi với V-ing.
Cụm động từ "catch on" = trở nên phổ biến.

g.title: B2 Use of English phần 3 · Learning to juggle
g.topic: Learning to juggle as an adult
g.gist: An article about adults who take up juggling and what it does for the brain.
g.vi: Đọc bài, dùng từ IN HOA cuối dòng để tạo từ đúng cho 8 chỗ trống.
g.text:
Learning to juggle

Juggling may look like a skill that only circus [1] need, but more and more adults are taking it up as a hobby. (PERFORM)
Beginners usually start with three soft balls, and the first few weeks can be [2] frustrating. (SURPRISE)
Most people drop the balls again and again, and some give up out of [3]. (BORED)
However, those who keep going often describe a real sense of [4] when they finally manage a full minute. (ACHIEVE)
There is also some [5] that learning a new physical skill can be good for the brain. (EVIDENT)
In one study, adults who practised for six weeks showed changes in areas linked to vision and [6]. (MOVE)
Teachers say that patience is more important than natural [7]. (ABLE)
And since the equipment is cheap and the hobby can be done almost anywhere, it is hardly [8] that clubs are appearing in many cities. (SURPRISE)

groups.inst: Use the word given in capitals to form a word that fits in the gap.

items.why_vi: Cần danh từ số nhiều chỉ người: "circus performers" (diễn viên xiếc).
Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "frustrating" cần trạng từ: "surprisingly frustrating".
Sau "out of" cần danh từ: "out of boredom" (vì chán).
"a sense of" + danh từ: "a sense of achievement" (cảm giác thành công).
"some" + danh từ không đếm được: "some evidence" (một số bằng chứng).
Song song với danh từ "vision": "vision and movement" (thị giác và vận động).
Sau tính từ "natural" cần danh từ: "natural ability" (năng khiếu).
"it is hardly + tính từ + that": "it is hardly surprising that" (chẳng có gì ngạc nhiên khi).

g.title: B2 Use of English phần 4 · Viết lại câu (bộ 1)
g.topic: Key word transformations about everyday situations
g.gist: Six key word transformation items about travel, work and study.
g.vi: Viết lại câu thứ hai cùng nghĩa câu đầu, dùng từ IN HOA, 2–5 từ.

groups.inst: Complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence, using the word given. Do not change the word given. You must use between two and five words, including the word given.

items.q:
I haven't been to the cinema for six months.
LAST
The ______ to the cinema was six months ago.
items.why_vi: "haven't … for six months" = "The last time I went … was six months ago".

items.q:
"Don't forget to lock the door," Maria told her brother.
REMINDED
Maria ______ the door.
items.why_vi: Câu tường thuật: "remind somebody to do something" = "reminded her brother to lock the door".

items.q:
It wasn't necessary for us to book a table.
NEED
We ______ a table.
items.why_vi: "It wasn't necessary" = "didn't need to book". "needn't have booked" cũng đúng (nhưng hàm ý đã đặt rồi).

items.q:
The concert was so popular that all the tickets sold out in an hour.
SUCH
It was ______ that all the tickets sold out in an hour.
items.why_vi: "so + tính từ" đổi thành "such + a + tính từ + danh từ": "such a popular concert".

items.q:
Tom started learning Spanish three years ago.
BEEN
Tom ______ Spanish for three years.
items.why_vi: Việc bắt đầu trong quá khứ và còn tiếp: hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn "has been learning … for three years".

items.q:
I regret not taking the job in London.
WISH
I ______ the job in London.
items.why_vi: Tiếc về quá khứ: "wish + quá khứ hoàn thành": "I wish I had taken the job".
